name: Valdeganga (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Valdeganga (a tower on green, an eagle on yellow and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valdeganga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdeganga arms — tower, eagle and waves
